author: Dawn Forrest
title: Christiansburg woman sentenced for 2-year-old daughter's death - NewsBreak
text:
By Dawn Forrest ,
1 hours ago
MONTGOMERY COUNTY, Va. ( WFXR ) – A Christiansburg woman will spend decades behind bars in the death of her two-year-old daughter.
Heather Renee Bentley was sentenced 45 years on Wednesday, June 10, according to Montgomery County Circuit Court documents, with 25 years suspended.
Forty years of the sentence are for felony child neglect, while the remaining five years are for second-degree murder charges.
Bentley was found guilty last year.
Christiansburg police arrested Bentley and Eric Raymond Thad Callis in 2024 after responders found an unresponsive child at a Montgomery County residence.
The two-year-old girl was pronounced dead at the scene, authorities said.
An investigation into the death led to the arrest of Bentley and Callis. Police charged them both with felony child neglect.
